cohort: The study included 323 probands with autism spectrum disorder, 257 unaffected siblings, and 1504 typically developing controls.
finding: Probands with autism spectrum disorder and their unaffected siblings experienced more prenatal and perinatal events than typically developing controls, with specific factors being associated with greater severity of autistic symptoms.
followup_time: Approximately 8.9 to 11.7 years after birth (based on mean age of participants)
